libs.note: BH-1940. The REST merge ladder's kill switch. Resolved by _gpm_knobs through lib_env_apply in a subshell, once per env value per process.

knobs.note: 1 merges over the REST ladder (gh_pr_merge_rest). 0 turns the ladder off and every caller runs its own gh pr merge line, as before BH-892; flags/pr-merge-rest-off does the same. Read by bin/lib/gh-pr-merge.sh with no literal since BH-1940; was ${PR_MERGE_REST:-1}. If nothing resolves it the ladder stays on.
